Asa user, I want to request money from the person I'm chatting with, and havethem see an interactive card they can fulfill, reject, or ignore.Acceptance Criteria● The "+" attachment menu's"Request money" option opens a sheet: amount + optional reason, witha fixed 48-hour request expiry shown● The recipient sees the request card withReject / Send actions ● Tapping Send opens a pre-filled Send Paymentsheet: the requester's reason auto-fills as an EDITABLE transfer narration,amount is editable● If the fulfiller sends the EXACT requestedamount: the transfer auto-credits immediately, no accept/decline step, matchesthe existing Sent/Received card design● If the fulfiller sends a DIFFERENT amount(more or less): the transfer enters the pending accept/decline state (Ticket: Pending Transfer Accept/Decline & Auto-Refund System) instead of auto-crediting ● If the original requester taps Reject on therequest itself, or the request goes unfulfilled for 48 hours, it shows Declined/ Expired respectively ● REINITIATE: an expired request shows arefresh-style "Send request again" action. Tapping it creates abrand-new request (new 48-hour timer) posted as a new card at the bottom of theconversation, it does NOT update the old expired card in place● A requester can cancel their own still-openrequest ● Any successfully completed transfer(auto-credited or accepted) shows a download-receipt action

Asa user receiving money I didn't request (or a mismatched amount against arequest I made), I want the choice to accept or decline it, so money isn'tcredited to my wallet without my say.Acceptance Criteria● the ONLYtransfer type that auto-credits with no confirmation is fulfilling a requestwith the exact requested amount. Every free-will send, and everymismatched-amount request fulfillment, requires the recipient to Accept orDecline● On send, the sender's funds are placed in aheld/reserved state (deducted from available balance, not yet credited to therecipient), not simply left in the sender's spendable balance while pending● The recipient has 24 hours to Accept orDecline● Accept: funds move from held state to therecipient's available balance● Decline, OR no action taken within 24 hours:funds are automatically returned to the sender's available balance● Push notification reminders are sent to therecipient during the 24-hour window prompting them to decide● Once resolved (accepted, declined, orauto-refunded), the in-chat card updates to reflect the outcome, consistentwith the existing Sent/Received/Declined card visual language

Asa Support or Compliance admin viewing a user's account, I want to see theirreal wallet balance and full transaction history, so I can actually answerquestions about their money instead of relying on a coarse status label.Acceptance Criteria● New Wallet section on the Customer Detail Pageshowing the user's current real balance● A full, paginated transaction list: type(wallet funding, P2P send/receive, external transfer, card spend), amount,counterparty where applicable, status, timestamp● Filterable by transaction type and date range,consistent with filtering patterns already used elsewhere in the admindashboard

Asa Support admin, when a user reports a stuck or missing transfer, I want tolook up that specific transfer and see exactly what state it's in, so I canresolve the complaint instead of escalating blindly.Acceptance Criteria● Look up a specific transfer by user, daterange, or transaction reference/ID● Show its full state: current status (pending /accepted / declined / auto-refunded / failed), time remaining if still pending,and resolution timestamp and method● A dedicated view surfacing transfers that arepending well past the 24-hour window with no resolution, this will be the earliest,most concrete signal the auto-refund job may have silently failed in production

AsCompliance or a backend-savvy admin, I want to compare Beevia's internal walletledger against Anchor's own transaction records, so discrepancies get caughtbefore they become a real financial or regulatory problem.Acceptance Criteria● Compare Beevia-recorded transactions againstAnchor's transaction records for a given period or specific user● Clearly surface mismatches: present in onesystem but not the other, or an amount mismatch between the two
Build the comparison logic pulling fromAnchor's transaction API and Beevia's own ledger.

Asan admin, I want to see a feed of recent notable activity across the admintool, so I have situational awareness without going through each module's ownhistory separately.Acceptance Criteria● A single, chronological feed combining recentevents already logged elsewhere in the system: admin invites sent, roleassignments changed, admin account deactivate/reactivate actions, and userstatus changes ● Each feed item links directly to the relevantrecord - e.g. clicking a "User suspended" event opens that user'sCustomer Detail Page● Respects the same permission-gating, an admin never sees a feed item from a module they don't have view access to
